records.reason: The concrete run/delivery invocation supplies {packet}, while deliver Inputs requires exactly {envelope}. There are no optional parameters or aliases and sealed is only an opaque value. This breaks the invocation signature structurally. The failing invocation is in the touched activity; every assigned row participates in this same argument-to-input comparison.

findings.summary: The delivery invocation supplies argument key packet, but deliver requires the exact input key envelope.
findings.fix: Set the invocation argument key to envelope, matching deliver Inputs exactly.

records.reason: The routine export report: emit.report resolves emit to produce, but the complete technique Outputs section declares only summary. report is absent. Markdown report mentions in Capability, Protocol, and Rules do not declare outputs. This is a structurally unresolved output binding. deliver is a closure consumer of the touched produce output contract, giving this defect diff attribution.

findings.summary: The routine report export references emit.report, but emit calls produce whose only declared output is summary.
findings.fix: Bind the routine report export to emit.summary, an output declared by produce.
